name: interniq
description: InternIQ - AI-assisted career and internship matching platform for St. Mary's University (senior project prototype)

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:mobile: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev:mobile --prefix client"
